product_overview: W Panda Express is a progressive web app for restaurant ordering that lets customers browse a location-based menu, build a cart, and submit orders through WhatsApp. It also includes an authenticated admin panel for managing locations, products, categories, settings, and orders.
core_goals: Browse the restaurant menu by category and product details
Select an open restaurant location to begin ordering
Build and manage a shopping cart with quantities and notes
Complete checkout with delivery or pickup details
Manage restaurant content and orders through the admin panel
Switch the interface language between Spanish, English, and Chinese
Install the app as a PWA

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: A public marketing homepage that introduces the restaurant, highlights featured dishes, shows locations and reviews, and directs customers into the ordering flow.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the hero section and restaurant introduction -> Scroll through featured dishes, locations, reviews, and social links -> Open the order flow from the call to action
Navigate to / -> Switch the interface language -> See the page text update immediately
Navigate to / -> Select a location card -> View the location details

features.name: Location Selection
features.description: The first step of the ordering flow where the customer chooses an available restaurant location to continue.
user_flows: Navigate to /pedir -> View the list of restaurant locations -> Select an open location -> Continue to the menu
Navigate to /pedir -> View the list of restaurant locations -> Observe that a closed location cannot be selected

features.name: Menu Browsing
features.description: A categorized menu experience where customers filter products, inspect details, and add items to the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Scroll through the category tabs -> Choose a category -> View the filtered products -> Open a product to see its details -> Add the product to the cart
Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Scroll through the category tabs -> Choose a category with no available items -> See an empty category state
Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Browse the product grid -> Observe that an out-of-stock product is disabled

features.name: Cart Management
features.description: A cart drawer that lets the customer review items, adjust quantities, and add special notes before checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Add a product to the cart -> Open the cart drawer -> View cart items, quantities, and totals -> Increase or decrease an item quantity -> Remove an item if needed -> Continue to checkout
Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Open the cart drawer -> Add a special note to an item -> Return to the cart summary -> See the note preserved for that item
Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Open the cart drawer with no items -> See the empty cart state

features.name: Checkout and Order via WhatsApp
features.description: The checkout flow for entering customer details, choosing delivery or pickup, setting a delivery location, reviewing totals, and sending the order through WhatsApp.
user_flows: Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Add items to the cart -> Open checkout -> Enter a valid name -> Enter a valid phone number -> Choose delivery -> Search for an address -> Select an address suggestion -> Review the map location and shipping fee -> Complete the order through WhatsApp

Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Add items to the cart -> Open checkout -> Enter a valid name -> Enter a valid phone number -> Choose pickup -> Review the order summary -> Complete the order through WhatsApp
Navigate to /pedir -> Select an open location -> Add items to the cart -> Open checkout -> Enter a delivery address outside the coverage range -> See that the order cannot be submitted

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: A protected management area for administrators to maintain locations, products, categories, restaurant settings, and orders.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Enter email and password -> Sign in -> View the admin dashboard counts for locations, products, and orders
Navigate to /admin -> Enter admin credentials -> Sign in -> Create a location -> Edit the location details -> Toggle the location active or inactive -> Delete the location
Navigate to /admin -> Enter admin credentials -> Sign in -> Create a product -> Edit the product details -> Toggle product availability -> Delete the product
Navigate to /admin -> Enter admin credentials -> Sign in -> Create a category -> Edit the category -> Delete the category

Navigate to /admin -> Enter admin credentials -> Sign in -> Open restaurant settings -> Update name, logo, colors, tax, delivery fee, exchange rate, distance pricing, and social links -> Save the changes
Navigate to /admin -> Enter admin credentials -> Sign in -> Open the orders list -> Review submitted orders
Navigate to /admin -> Visit /admin without signing in -> See the login screen

features.name: Multi-language Support
features.description: A language toggle available across the app that switches the interface between Spanish, English, and Chinese.
user_flows: Navigate to any supported route -> Change the language to English -> See all visible UI text update
Navigate to any supported route -> Change the language to Chinese -> See all visible UI text update
Navigate to any supported route -> Change the language back to Spanish -> See all visible UI text update

features.name: PWA Support
features.description: Progressive Web App behavior that offers installation when supported by the browser.
user_flows: Navigate to any supported route -> Wait for the install prompt to appear -> Choose to install the app -> Add the app to the home screen
